title: Romanchakam
description: A cocky engineering grad starts a dating app to prove he can succeed at anything. But a mysterious online connection turns his world upside down. Between a failed startup, money trouble, and crazy moments with his friends, things get messy when a strange encounter hints at something darker. What starts as a desperate chase for a girl becomes a tough journey inward--where he learns the hardest person to understand isn't someone else, but himself.
